execution_requirements: Only source/text read; no Java/Maven/DB/provider executed. Use isolated exact EXTRA candidate tree, never overwrite active source writers.

Run unit/mock/H2 with DB gates unset; H2 is not MySQL-lock evidence. Explicit -Dtest selectors needed because *MySqlIT may not match Surefire defaults. Serial classes and junit.jupiter.execution.parallel.enabled=false; fixed H2 memory names must not race.

For real DB use dedicated authorized scratch MySQL only, never production host/schema/account; supply CHENGYIN_TEST_MYSQL_HOST/PORT/DATABASE_BASE/DATABASE_SUFFIX/USER/PASSWORD explicitly. Empty explicit PASSWORD may be allowed; other required fields nonempty. Enable only the intended class gate listed in entries.

Fresh SQL-safe unique suffix per run/class and combined identifier <=64 chars. E04 suites declaring e04_scratch base must receive that exact value. UUID suite fragments add isolation, not permission to reuse suffix. CREATE/DROP DB/table/DML privileges needed.
E01_06 requires PROCESS/information_schema.innodb_trx to observe exact connection LOCK WAIT; lack permission is failure. Session innodb_lock_wait_timeout changes remain connection scoped.

A03EndingSnapshotMySqlIT separately requires ENDING gate and CHENGYIN_MYBATIS_IT_HOST=127.0.0.1, PORT USER PASSWORD DB_SUFFIX. Suffix _[a-z0-9_]{1,24}; schema chengyin_mybatis_a03_ending_snapshot<suffix>. Source explicitly requires MySQL 8.0, so >=9 fails unlike generic helper >=8.

Per-class boundary lines preserve CREATE/DROP/guards; old adjacent helpers may pre-DROP a fixed derived name: run only unique authorized scratch. New collision-fail suites only drop schema they created; independently record cleanup.

No live paid AI/WeChat/payment/OSS/HTTP callback required by primary suites; fixture cdn.example URLs are data. Do not start full application/jobs or enable unrelated external provider/Redis gates. Maven dependency egress is tooling only. Redis mocks/mentions are not true Redis coverage.
